appearances.snippet: There. And then Rudy went out and stood on the steps of the New Castle County Courthouse with Bernie Kerrick and said this contains child exploitation, like pure, you know, I mean, pure bullshit, just bullshit. So on both sides, you have this reaction.

verification.notes: Transcript context shows Hunter Biden quoting Rudy Giuliani, so the verifiable proposition is that Giuliani made the accusation, not that the accusation was true. Giuliani's sworn January 6 Committee deposition records him asserting that the hard drive contained material he characterized as child pornography. No reliable evidence substantiates the underlying allegation.
